name: wds_vtab-flowers
description: A vision transfer-learning dataset derived from the VTAB/flowers split (streamed via WebDataset) used to evaluate image classification and feature-transfer performance on a flower species recognition task. It measures how well pre-trained models or representations adapt to this specific fine-grained visual classification domain.
reputation: Part of the VTAB-style transfer-evaluation family and commonly used for representation-transfer experiments; recognized in the transfer-learning community.
